answer.summary: The API Types Check failed because the committed generated TypeScript types are stale. The PR adds new API fields (payload_revoked, action_payload_managed, action_payload_revoked, action_payload_version) that the generator produced but the commit does not include. The log itself says to run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the result. The same diff will appear on every re-run, so retrying will not help. Fix: regenerate the types, commit them, and push.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
